Who we are

Our Vision

At Office Line, we aspire to be far more than a supplier of office and technical solutions: to inspire a shift in awareness within a society built on human values, and to be a loyal, committed partner even in the most difficult times.

Our Mission

Listening to our customers, supporting them at every stage — from choosing equipment to growing their business — and providing flawless after-sales service.

Our Values

Shared vision, unwavering commitment and customer satisfaction: the foundations of our success since 1993.

Simplify your daily operations and boost your productivity with our comprehensive solutions, designed for professionals.

Whether you're equipping an office or a production workshop, we support you every step of the way to make your work environment more pleasant, better organized and noticeably more efficient. Relying on our reliable equipment, high-quality consumables and responsive technical service, you're free to focus on what matters most: the success of your projects.

Lighten your days and boost your output with our comprehensive solutions, specially designed for professionals. From office supplies to the most advanced technical equipment, we guide you every step of the way to transform your workspace into a more pleasant, better structured and noticeably more efficient place.

Why choose Office Line?

Why choose Office Line?

With over three decades of experience, recognized expertise and a dedicated team, Office Line is the ideal choice to equip and support your success.

01

Our strengths

Exclusive distributor of Trodat (1993) and Trotec (1997), official distributor of Roland DG and ACCO Brands (2008). A network of over 2,000 distributors and a catalog of more than 4,000 products.

02

Our clients

90% of our business is B2B: stationers, office supply retailers, IT resellers, printers, engravers and stamp makers across Algeria.

03

Our services

Warranty from 1 to 25 years depending on the product, and qualified after-sales service: installation, repair, training, diagnostics and phone support.
